questions.question: A copper wire is bent in the form of a square and it encloses an area of 30.25 cm². If the same wire is bent to form a circle, then find the area of the circle.[Usе π = (22)/(7)]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Copper wire bent to square for area = 30.25 cm²

**Formula used:**

Area of a square = (side)²

Perimeter of square = 4 × side

Circumference of circle = 2 × π × r

Area of circle = π × r²

**Calculation:**

Area of square = 30.25 cm²

⇒ a² = 30.25

⇒ a = √30.25

⇒ a = 5.5 cm

Perimeter of square = 4 × a

⇒ 4 × 5.5 = 22 cm

Now,

Circumference of circle = 22 cm

⇒ 2 × π × r = 22

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 22

⇒ r = 7/2 = 3.5 cm

Area of circle = π × r²

⇒ (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5

⇒ 22 × 0.5 × 3.5 = 38.50 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 38.50 cm2.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper publishes a list of prices which are 60% above the CP. He proposes to give 20% discount. How much profit does he really make?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = 160% × Cost price (C.P)

Discount% = 20%

**Formula used:**

If discount = D% then,

Selling price (S.P) = M.P × (100 - D)%

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit% = (P × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

Marked price (M.P) = 160% × Cost price (C.P)

M.P/C.P = 160/100

M.P = 160 and C.P = 100

Selling price (S.P) = 160 × (100 - 20)%

⇒ 160 × 80% = Rs.128

Profit% = {(128 - 100) × 100}/100

⇒ 28%

**∴ The correct answer is 28%. **

questions.question: If (a + b + c) = 17, and (a² + b² + c²) = 115, find the value of (a + b)² + (b + c)² + (c + a)².
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(a + b + c) = 17

And (a2 + b2 + c2) = 115

**Formula used:**

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2 (ab + bc + ca) 

**Calculation:**

(a + b + c) = 17

Squaring both sides 

⇒ (a + b + c)² = (17)²

⇒ a² + b² + c² + 2 × (ab + bc + ca) = 289

⇒ 2 × (ab + bc + ca) = 289 - 115

⇒ 2 × (ab + bc + ca) = 174

Now,

⇒ (a + b)2 + (b + c)2 + (c + a)2

⇒ a² + b² + 2ab + b² + c² + 2bc + c² + a² + 2ca

⇒ 2 × (a² + b² + c²) + 2 × (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2 × 115 + 174 = 404

**∴ The correct answer is 404.**

questions.question: A deposited ₹1,56,250 at 8% simple interest for 2 years. How much more money will A have in his account at the end of two years, if at the same rate of interest the sum is invested in compound interest, compounded annually
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.156250

Time = 2 years ; Rate% = 8% 

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

C.I = P × effective rate for T years

For C.I:

Effective rate for 2 years = R₁ + R₂ + {(R₁ × R₂)/100}

Where, S.I = simple interest ; C.I = compound interest

and P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time 

**Calculation:**

Effective rate for 2 years = (8 × 2)% = 16%

⇒ S.I = 156250 × 16%

The effective rate for 2 years = 8 + 8 + (8 × 8)/100

⇒ 16 + 0.64 = 16.64%

C.I = 156250 × 16.64%

Required difference = 156250 × (16.64 - 16)

⇒ 156250 × 0.64% = Rs.1000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.1000.**

questions.question:
Simplify:

(2a - 3b - c)² - (a + 2b + c)²
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Apply the **Difference of Squares** identity: **x² − y² = (x + y)(x − y)**.

Let **x = (2a − 3b − c)** and **y = (a + 2b + c)**.

**Sum (x + y)** = (2a − 3b − c) + (a + 2b + c) = **3a − b**.

**Difference (x − y)** = (2a − 3b − c) − (a + 2b + c) = **a − 5b − 2c**.

**Result** = (3a − b)(a − 5b − 2c) = **3a² + 5b² − 16ab + 2bc − 6ac**.

**∴ The correct answer is 3a² + 5b² − 16ab + 2bc − 6ac.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (2a − 3b − c)² − (a + 2b + c)²

**Formula Used:** (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2xy + 2yz + 2zx

⇒ (2a − 3b − c)² = (2a)² + (−3b)² + (−c)² + 2(2a)(−3b) + 2(−3b)(−c) + 2(−c)(2a)

⇒ (2a − 3b − c)² = 4a² + 9b² + c² − 12ab + 6bc − 4ac

⇒ (a + 2b + c)² = a² + (2b)² + c² + 2(a)(2b) + 2(2b)(c) + 2(c)(a)

⇒ (a + 2b + c)² = a² + 4b² + c² + 4ab + 4bc + 2ac

⇒ Final Expression = (4a² + 9b² + c² − 12ab + 6bc − 4ac) − (a² + 4b² + c² + 4ab + 4bc + 2ac)

⇒ Final Expression = 3a² + 5b² − 16ab + 2bc − 6ac

**∴ The correct answer is 3a² + 5b² − 16ab + 2bc − 6ac.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity x² − y²

The difference of two squares can be factored into the product of the sum and the difference of the terms: **x² − y² = (x + y)(x − y)**.

Expansion of a Trinomial Square

For any three terms, **(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca**. Care must be taken with the **signs** of each term during expansion.

Combining Like Terms

Simplification requires identifying **like terms** (terms with the same variable and exponent) and performing addition or subtraction on their coefficients.</p

questions.question: In one hour each, a boat goes 12 km along the stream and 8 km against the stream. What is the speed of the boat in still water (in km/h)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance along the stream = 12 km

Distance against the stream = 8 km

**Concept used:**

Speed of boat along with stream = U + V

Speed of boat against with stream = U - V

U = speed of boat and V = speed of stream

**Calculation:**

Speed of boat along with stream = U + V = 12 km/h

Speed of boat against with stream = U - V = 8 km/h

Speed of boat (U) = (12 + 8)/2

⇒ 20/2 = 10 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 10 km/h. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__****Given:**

Distance traveled downstream in one hour = 12 km

Distance traveled upstream in one hour = 8 km

**Concept Used:**

Speed along the stream (downstream) = speed of boat in still water + speed of stream (u + v)

Speed against the stream (upstream) = speed of boat in still water - speed of stream ( u - v)

**Calculation:**

Downstream speed: u + v = 12 km/h

Upstream speed: u - v = 8 km/h

Solve the system of equations:

Adding the equations:

⇒ (u + v) + (u - v) = 12 + 8

⇒ 2u = 20

⇒ u = 10 km/h.

Subtracting the equations:

⇒ (u + v) - (u - v) = 12 - 8

⇒ 2v = 4

⇒ v = 2 km/h.

**∴ The speed of the boat in still water (u) is 10 km/h.**

**Answer: 10 km/h.**

questions.question: If sec θ + tan θ = 5, then Sin θ = ______.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If **sec θ + tan θ = k**, then **sec θ − tan θ = 1/k**.

Given k = 5, then sec θ − tan θ = 1/5.

Adding both: 2 sec θ = 5 + 1/5 = 26/5 ⇒ sec θ = 13/5.

Using **triplet (5, 12, 13)**: If Hypotenuse = 13 and Base = 5, then Perpendicular = 12.

sin θ = Perpendicular / Hypotenuse = 12/13.

**∴ The correct answer is 12/13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4622aa72b57e067f70ad03c4aeb23fa0afb88c9e548a003f52b87ec7b9e53912.png] 

**Given:** sec θ + tan θ = 5 --- (i)

**Formula Used:** sec² θ − tan² θ = 1

⇒ (sec θ + tan θ)(sec θ − tan θ) = 1

⇒ 5 × (sec θ − tan θ) = 1

⇒ sec θ − tan θ = 1/5 --- (ii)

⇒ Adding (i) and (ii): 2 sec θ = 5 + 0.2 = 5.2

⇒ sec θ = 2.6 = 26/10 = 13/5

⇒ Since sec θ = Hypotenuse / Base, let H = 13 and B = 5.

⇒ P = √(H² − B²) = √(169 − 25) = √144 = 12

⇒ sin θ = P / H = 12/13

**∴ The correct answer is 12/13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Standard identities include sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 and 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Pythagorean Triplets

Common triplets used in exams: (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (7, 24, 25), (8, 15, 17), and (9, 40, 41).

Reciprocal Relations

sec θ = 1/cos θ and tan θ = sin θ/cos θ. If sec θ + tan θ = x, then sec θ = (x² + 1)/2x and tan θ = (x² − 1)/2x.</p
